title: Advanced Topics in Political Theory
description: Topics may include comparative political theory; political authority; identity politics; labour, work and political theory; political dissent; politics of rights; political theories of catastrophe; themes from the history of political thought; theories of freedom and action; theories of race and gender.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of POLI 501, POLI 401, POLI 533 (if taken in the same topic).
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate course.
